## Acceptance Criteria
- storage-sync.ts implements S3 file copying from production to sandbox
- Respects INCLUDE_S3_SYNC secret (default: false, opt-in)
- Applies size limits (5GB per bucket max)
- Only copies recent files (last N days matching DAYS_RECENT)
- Handles 5 buckets: reportBlockDetails, dataSources, scoreResultAttachments, taskAttachments, rubricMemory

## Implementation Steps
- Use Amplify Storage API: list(), downloadData(), uploadData()
- Filter files by lastModified >= cutoff date
- Track total bytes per bucket, stop at 5GB limit
- Log progress every 10 files
- Handle errors gracefully (skip failed files, continue)
